title: Local–Global Identity Salience and Creativity: The Mediating Role of Group-Based Pride
authors: Sijie Sun, Ravi Mehta, Zhiyong Yang, Narayan Janakiraman

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: Local–Global Identity Salience and Creativity: The Mediating Role of Group-Based Pride

eligible_reason: Experiments plus cross-sectional secondary data. The preliminary study is a cross-section of crowdsourcing-platform submissions (LOCAL1GLOBAL0, consumer voting ratings, votes, followers, membership duration); Studies 1-5 are field and lab experiments analysed with ANOVA/ANCOVA/chi-square and PROCESS. No panel, no DiD.
design_notes: 18 data files (csv originals of Dataverse .tab), preregistration PDFs, Readme.docx (SPSS 27, PROCESS 4.2, CMA 4.0). No code files.
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract, README and data headers.
main_text_note: Article confirms experiments plus cross-sectional secondary data from the Threadless crowdsourcing platform; no DiD terms.
